brief: Something to keep my sewing supplies tidy.

requirements.requirement: Keep sewing supplies tidy (compartmentalized desktop caddy)
requirements.evidence: 3-cell cluster (piece 0,0,0 + 0,1,0 + 1,0,0) with 3 bins: 2x hex-bin-full-div2 (2 compartments each) and 1x hex-bin-full-div3 (3 compartments) = 7 compartments total for thread, needles, buttons, scissors, measuring tools.

One prop heap-screws-div2 placed in bin 0,0,0 to illustrate small notions/buttons; additional props (tape measure, pliers as scissor-stand-in, etc.) were refused by BUSY settling – build itself shows purpose via compartmentalized bins.

finish.summary: Compact 3-cell tidy caddy with 7 compartments across 3 bins (2+2+3) – sized for bobbins, buttons, needles, scissors, tape measure and fabric scraps. Capped and joint-bolted, ready for desktop sewing station.

lines.label: M6 x 25 socket head screw, ISO 4762

notes: Tighten every M6 to 2 N.m: HAND TOOLS ONLY, never a cordless driver. These bolts clamp printed PETG, not metal: at the bolt's own 10.4 N.m rating the head crushes the plastic under it and the joint fails silently, looking tight while holding nothing. Snug, then a nudge. Re-check the bolts after the first few weeks: PETG relaxes under load and the clamp will have eased.
